errors.text: The proposed oxide dispersion intervention is unrelated to the target in situ thermal treatment and observation of intrinsic instability.
Grain-boundary pinning does not address the target failure mechanism: rapid surface-energy-driven Au/Cu segregation, melting, and evaporation in sub-10 nm particles.
None of the cited evidence demonstrates oxide-dispersion stabilization of multielement solid-solution nanoparticles under high-temperature catalytic conditions.
The oxide identity, loading, spatial distribution, and introduction method are unspecified, so compatibility with a multielement solid solution cannot be assessed.
No particular catalytic application or low-noble-metal compositional boundary is given.
